fonts.name: ABC Dinamo
fonts.note: Really good grotesks, monos and serifs (Diatype, Favorit, Monument Grotesk…). Paid licences, with trial fonts for mockups

fonts.name: Fontshare
fonts.note: Indian Type Foundry's free fonts (Satoshi, General Sans, Clash Display, Cabinet Grotesk, Switzer, Erode). Free for commercial use, with a hosted CSS API. The closest free match to Dinamo

fonts.name: Velvetyne
fonts.note: French libre foundry. Experimental, characterful display type, all OFL

fonts.name: Collletttivo
fonts.note: Italian open-source type collective (Apfel Grotezk). Quirky grotesks

fonts.name: Uncut
fonts.note: Curated catalogue of contemporary free and libre typefaces. Good for browsing

fonts.name: Open Foundry
fonts.note: Hand-picked open-source fonts with nice specimens

fonts.name: Badass Libre Fonts by Womxn
fonts.note: Libre fonts by women and non-binary designers. Strong display faces

fonts.name: Tunera Type Foundry
fonts.note: Small libre foundry with expressive serifs and display faces

fonts.name: Google Fonts
fonts.note: What theme.mjs loads from. The good ones: Instrument Serif, Fraunces, Bricolage Grotesque, Space Grotesk, Geist, Geist Mono, Inter

fonts.name: Atipo Foundry
fonts.note: Pay what you want, including nothing

fonts.name: Pangram Pangram
fonts.note: Neue Montreal, Editorial New. Free trials for mockups only; commercial use needs a paid licence
